description: Manages global system settings and application parameters that define the behavior and environment of the application.

endpoints.name: Get
endpoints.description: Retrieves the current global system configuration and application settings. This endpoint provides read-only access to various parameters that govern the application's behavior.
example_uses: How do I get the current application settings?
Show me all the system configuration details.
I need to see the global parameters for the application.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to retrieve the current state of the application's global configuration settings, such as API keys, feature flags, or environment-specific parameters. It's suitable for displaying system information or for internal application processes that require configuration values.
